name: ShowMeBestAI

sources.title: Submit your AI Tool — pricing page with FREE ($0), BASIC ($9.99) and PRO ($49.99) listing tiers

requirements: AI tools only — the site is a dedicated AI tools directory
Free listing tier exists ('FREE Listing $0') alongside paid BASIC ($9.99) and PRO ($49.99) tiers
Free tier claims a dofollow backlink, basic AI tool page, limited category/search visibility, review in 24 hours
preparation: AI tool name, URL, and description
Payment details only if choosing the $9.99 Basic or $49.99 Pro upgrade
workflow: Choose the FREE listing tier ('Submit Now' under FREE $0) unless paid visibility is wanted
Complete the submission form for the tool
watchFor: Two paid upsell tiers sit next to the free option — BASIC ($9.99, 1 dofollow backlink, listing forever) and PRO ($49.99, 5+ dofollow backlinks, featured for 6 months)
PRO 'featured' placement is time-limited (6 months) despite the one-time fee framing
Free tier offers 'limited' visibility in categories and search results
Guest Post tab exists alongside Listing — confirm you are on the Listing tab
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a public listing page on showmebest.ai and shows up in its category/search
unknowns: Exact submission form fields (the submit page shows pricing tiers; the form itself is behind 'Submit Now')
Whether the free tier's claimed dofollow backlink holds in practice
Review/rejection criteria beyond the 24-hour review claim
